caption:
Austin apartment asking rents moved both ways last week.

AustinApartments.com compared advertised starting rents for the same 5,696 floor plans at 810 Austin-area apartment communities on November 15 and 22. It found that 221 communities lowered the asking rent on at least one floor plan, while 192 raised it on at least one. Those counts overlap: 60 communities did both.

The report counted a change only if it was at least $50 and at least 3%. If you’re comparing apartments, ask for the price and required fees for the exact unit, move-in date and lease length you want. A deal on one layout may not carry over to another in the same building.

Source: AustinApartments.com weekly rent report, November 23, 2026.
